There! All done - bet you boys are happy this little inspection is over, eh? Shake off the tension, and all that.
Where's the Artifact?
Is it over?
Tension? I'm sure I don't know what you mean.
...You were going to tell us something, I believe?

A democracy? How modern. You guys are regular progressives, huh? That said, though - one of you has to be the senior one, isn't that right? If there's something I know, boys, it's that there's always someone out here calling the shots.
Well, in that case...I'm the senior.
Not in our case. We decide things together.
I suppose, technically, Jorge is the head scientist.
...I'll level with you fellas, that doesn't sound great. Sounds like neglect to me.
We were hoping HQ would be understanding of the circumstances.
We just weren't sure how to treat it. We're as disappointed as you are, I'm sure.
[Say nothing]
Feed? Oh man, that sounds creepy. Little weird experiment thing chomping down on snacks - well, now that I think about it, that would have been fun to see.
We're, well, hoping that HQ  will be understanding about the whole thing.
Unfortunately, however, given the circumstances, that's not going to happen.
[Say nothing]
You don't say. Well, fellas, I hope there's something to look at, at least. I'd hate to come all this way to just see...I don't know, a puddle of goo.
Of course. Anything else you'd like to know?
That might be exactly it, unfortunately. Would you like to see it now?
...Well, it is what it is! Disappointed, for sure. But tell the truth, if the thing was dangerous, at least we won't be in danger now.
Yes. Any other questions.
We're very sorry. Would you like to see it now?
They ain't going to be singing your praises, I reckon - but who knows. Maybe I can put in a good word for the two of you, you know, between us friends.
We'd appreciate that. Would you like to see it now?
Anything else you need to know right now?

Not one to take credit for yourself, are you? Alright, that's fine. I'll make sure to keep that in mind, and hey, I should talk to your colleague about it as well. Just, uh, word to the wise, bud - being humble never got anyone a fancy car or a sexy title.
I don't care about either of those things.
I believe hard work pays off.
Oh, I'm still expecting a promotion. The work we've done here is groundbreaking.
I can tell - the right side is his side of the tent, no? It's got that holier-than-thou aesthetic to it, don't it? He been trying to convert you?
Convert me? Not that I've noticed, no.
It's fine. Jorge keeps it to himself for the most part.
Honestly, I welcome the spirituality. It's hopeful, if nothing else.

Fair enough - but you're the boss, though. Ain't you? When push comes to shove, you're the lead in all this, and that's who HQ is going to be looking at. Who knows - maybe you'll come out of this with a massive promotion. A new title. Perhaps even a car like mine.
I don't care about any of that, actually.
Hard work pays off. That's nothing new.
Make no mistake - I'm fully expecting a promotion after the work we've done here.

Alright, alright. I know, I know - democracy 'til the end, ain't that it? It's real nice to see the two of you working together like this, it truly is - but only one of you is going to get their name on this thing once it's over. Sharing never got anyone a fancy car or a sexy title.
I don't care about titles, even less so cars.
I believe hard work pays off. That's that.
Oh, I'm fully expecting a promotion after the work we've done here.
Sure, sure - looks like your colleague does, though. He was eyeing my ride real good when I came in, asking all sorts of questions about it. Bet he'd like to have one, some day.
He's not like that.
...I'm sorry, are you insinuating something?
The man likes cars. That's nothing unusual.
Oh, is that so? Must have got confused momentarily there - sorry about that, bossman! Your assistent here gave me a...different impression.
...He did, did he?
Probably just a case of miscommunication.
Ah, we take turns. Every week or so, we swap who's in charge. Like a democracy.

That's a nice sentiment, sure. I'll have to check with your boss to see whether he agrees or not, of course. Foremen, right? Always tend to take the credit for themselves, don't they? Always eyeing that next promotion, or a new expensive car.
I don't care about promotions or cars.
Hard work pays off. As it should.
For good reason, too - I'm fully expecting a promotion after the work we've done here.

I don't think that's relevant to our conversation.

He's worked hard his whole life to be what he is today. I suppose he's...inspiring.
He can be a bit of a prick.

I don't think that's relevant to our conversation.

[Lie] Not at all. Him and I are old friends.

Yeah, I didn't take you for the religious type! Not much room for the Shepherd in Science City, right? Then again, I suppose, there usually ain't much room for people like Jorge, either.
He's certainly dealt with his unfair share of prejudice, if that's what you mean.
Most of my colleagues were born into Science City. Jorge had to work hard for it.
Truth be told, I don't know why he pushed so hard to get there. I don't think he likes it much.

Yeah? Alright, different strokes, I suppose. It's certainly more popular with people like him, that's for sure. You have to believe that things will get better than living in the West End, right? Hah!
...I suppose that's right. Jorge certainly worked hard to be in a place that ended up treating him poorly.
There's nothing wrong with living in the West End.
Do you have a problem with people from Jorge's neighbourhood?
Oh, bet. Banter, I'm sure.

[Say nothing]

I can assure you, Jorge is among the best of the best.

You know what it is? Spite. Got to prove to them rich boys that you could, even if you wouldn't! I'll hand it to the guy, he certainly likes walking uphill. Kind of, well, sweet, when you think about it like that.
[Say nothing]

We'll go through the rest of it together, then.
...Anything interesting?

Is that right? Well well, boys, can't say I expected this kind of hospitality before - usually, it's all shy, awkward nerds standing around with papers in their hands. You two are a breath of fresh air, I'll tell you that much!
Sorry, I don't think I caught your name.
You have to do what you can to keep the days out here interesting.
...Thank you. So, where would you like to start?

Not my intent.
Maybe we should get on with work, then.
Oh, for sure - as you are one! That don't necessarily mean he doesn't see the reflection of Science City in those fancy glasses of yours, though. Oh, and speaking of - nice glasses.
...Thank you.
Should we get on with work now?
Preaching to the choir, brother. Professionalism, that's the key. Nothing wrong with being sociable, of course - but when it falls onto the other end of the spectrum, well...that's tough.
That's what I say. Keep the childish nonsense away from work.
Speaking of professionalism, how about we get back to work?

Sure. I just saw some of the pages at the start. You know, it's funny to see you write about your old pal in there - almost like you're trying to figure him out, get to know him. Ain't nothing like friendships where you keep learning things about each other, huh?
Oh, yes. We didn't actually know each other before this assignment - it just feels like it.
...Moving on - should we review the journal now?
...Yes, quite.

Of course. Sorry for the misunderstanding.

Hah! Man, it really is wild out here, huh? You two had the chance to call dibs on your own private kingdom, but you're ruling it like it's...I don't know, less fun than that. But hey, I'm not here to yuck anyone's yum. You guys do whatever works for you, that's what I say.

Who knows - maybe it would work for a lot of other people, too.
Noted. What can we do for you?

There we go, August 14th...I see your colleague mentioned something about a low hum. This turned out to be the scientific discovery of the century, I presume?
Yes, the artifact.
We haven't reached quite a conclusion on that just yet, I'm afraid.
No, we believe that's something else entirely.
Right, right - of course! Listen, I keep thinking about it; what's it like out here? You know, being out in the wilds, the wilderness, the Wastes.
Like I said, it's fine. You get used to it.
It's a struggle, that's for sure.
Haven't given it much thought.

I bet, I bet. You fellas got plenty of supplies? Food, water? Those solar panels come in handy, I'm sure, but it's not as though you can eat whatever comes out of them cables. You two ever gone foraging out here? Looking for...shit, plants? Roots? Whatever's edible.
There's nothing edible out here, I can assure.
The thought never crossed our minds.
We've never needed to worry about food.

Really? The heat and the dust out here seems enough to drive a man insane, if you ask me! You don't worry about, shit, sandstorms? Being cooked alive by the sun? Vicious monsters of the wastes, creeping in to prey on two unsuspecting fellas like yourselves?
...Monsters? No, that's ridicu...that's highly implausible.
We take precautions. That's about all we can do.
We try not to worry. Too much work to have time for that.

Really? Man, I can't imagine. I'd go crazy in a day or two, I'm sure. The heat, the dust, the...emptiness, if it indeed is empty out here. Not worried something horrible is going to come walking into camp some day and tear you fellas to shreds?
That seems highly unlikely, so no.
We've never really considered that possibility.
[Stare at the visitor]

I can tell it shook you, though. Right here, you wrote that you don't think the wastes are as bad as HQ made 'em out to be - even called it a lie! Is that true? I thought this little discovery of yours was highly dangerous.
Ah, yes...that was before we realized just how dangerous this thing was.
[Say nothing]
It is. We, uh...I disagree on some other points they made.

No kidding. Don't mind me, just skimming the next couple entries...and I'll say, I'm glad to see you took HQ's warnings about the wastes to heart. Nothing but death and danger out here, huh? I suppose you fellas even proved them right!
So it would seem.
[Say nothing]
Of course. We have to rely on HQ.

Sure, sure. Now, let's have a look...well, I'm seeing some interesting scribbles here - you fellas figured HQ was lying about the wastes, huh? "Lie". That's a strong word, for sure - bet you didn't mean to sound that harsh, did you?
I said what I said.
Well, we found life, didn't we?

No kidding. Now, let's see...oh, I like this - not only do you agree with HQ about the wastes not being able to sustain life, but you fellas went and proved it! No wonder your little friend died off - seems to me like everything out here is destined to die.
Of course. Who are we to argue with HQ?
To be fair, it was alive at first. I believe they should reconsider their theories on the wastes.
...Not everything, but I see your point.

Sorry, I don't think I caught your name.
I can assure you I have plenty of qualifications beyond my apparel.

I don't care. We're right, and they're wrong.
If their hypothesis is incorrect, they should be made aware.
...There's room for debate, is all we're saying.
No kidding. Now, let's see here - well, looks like being experts comes with some amount of acknowledging when HQ's right! You fellas agree that the wastes are all gloom and doom, huh?
Yes. That's why it's important to get this thing back to the City, where it's safe.
...Well, we did find life out here.

Let's.
